variables.name: wds/focus/ring/width
variables.description: focus ring width — 2px (the WCAG 2.4.13 minimum thickness; raise to 3px for more visibility)

variables.name: wds/focus/ring/offset
variables.description: focus ring offset — 2px (separates ring from the element edge)

variables.name: wds/focus/ring/offset-field
variables.description: focus ring offset, form fields — 0px (the ring sits on the field edge, so it does not collide with adjacent fields)
